newsitem.title: INDIA: India ITC official detained in probe.
newsitem.headline: India ITC official detained in probe.

text.p: Tobacco and hotel conglomerate Indian Tobacco Company on Wednesday said one of its employees had been detained by officials of India's Enforcement Directorate for questioning.

"Some enforcement directorate officials have come here," the firm's spokeswoman Aditi Syam told Reuters by telephone from ITC headquarters in Calcutta. "They have detained Mr Kutty of the International Business Division for questioning."
She denied rumours that other senior ITC officials have been arrested.
The ITC share plunged 17 rupees, or 5.3 percent, to 304.25, on the Bombay Stock Exchange, shortly after noon on rumours that senior ITC staff had been arrested by the authorities.
Three former employees of ITC were also detained, Syam added. Chairman Yogesh Deveshwar was in New Delhi, she said.

Senior ITC officials have been accused of violations of India's Foreign Exchange Regulation Act (FERA) in connection with some of the firm's export deals. The firm also has a long-standing dispute with federal tax authorities over excise payments.
British tobacco giant B.A.T. Industries plc owns about 31 percent of ITC.
